API Documentation | Brandmerch Developers

# Gifting API

Send branded merchandise programmatically. Integrate gifting into your CRM, sales workflows, or any application with a simple REST API.

## Quick Start

Three steps to send your first gift programmatically.

### Get your API key

Go to Dashboard → Integrations and create an API key. Available on the Stockroom subscription and Business plans.

### Add designs to a collection

Group the produced designs you want to ship into a collection. The API sends from any design with stock in your warehouse.

### Create a send

POST to /api/v2/sends with recipient address and design IDs. We handle fulfillment and shipping.

## Authentication

All API requests require a valid API key passed in the `X-API-Key` header. Keys are scoped to your company and available on the Stockroom subscription and Business plans.

```
curl "https://api.brandmerch.com/api/v1/sends/inventory?collectionId=col_welcome_kits" \
  -H "X-API-Key: bm_live_your_key_here"
```

SHA-256 hashed

Keys are stored as irreversible hashes

Company-scoped

Each key is tied to one company account

Revocable instantly

Revoke any key from the dashboard immediately

## Base URL

`https://api.brandmerch.com`

## API Endpoints

Click any endpoint to expand the full documentation.

POST`/api/v1/sends` Create a send

GET`/api/v1/sends/inventory` Check inventory by collection or design IDs

GET`/api/v1/sends/:id` Get send status & tracking

## Error Codes

All errors return a JS

# SwagUp API: Submit an Order Request

Written by Maggie Johnson

August 16, 2023

Table of contents

# Step One: Design Selected Products

The first step is to design the products you chose and make them “account products” (ie - products that are tied to a specific account). This request does not include payment.

Once you make this request, it will trigger us to start working on mockup designs. You will receive an email notification when they are ready. Part of the request is to include the logo(s) you want to put in your swag. Two(2) logos are the maximum allowed: primary and secondary. To upload your logo(s), there is an available AWS S3 bucket that our system will pull the images from. You can make a PUT request for uploading your logos to this bucket. The AWS S3 bucket is https://swagup-order-req-resources.s3.amazonaws.com. ​ ​

To submit a product design request you must make a POST request to:

https://api.swagup.com/api/v1/account-products/ ​ ​

There are 2 cases in the request payload structure:

- Submit a design request for pack products
- Submit a design request for individual products

Manage branded merchandise across departments, regions, and remote offices — with multi-storefront access, automated onboarding kits, brand governance, and API-driven workflows built for scale.

One platform for multi-department storefronts, global shipping, brand governance, and end-to-end automation.

Ship branded merchandise to remote employees, regional offices, and international locations from centralized warehouse inventory.

### Brand governance

Lock down logos, colors, decoration methods, and approved vendors. Every department orders from the same brand-governed catalog.

### API & automation

### Multi-storefront

Spin up separate storefronts for each department, region, or use case — with unique catalogs, budgets, and access controls per store.

# Corporate gifting platform for branded sends at scale

Curate branded merchandise, stock it in a real warehouse, and send it to prospects, customers, and employees — automatically from your CRM, via API, or through a self-serve gift storefront.

## Built-in tools for every step of the send

From catalog setup to delivery tracking — every workflow in one dashboard.

### Brand-controlled catalogs

Build curated collections with approved products, decoration placements, and color palettes. Lock down what can be sent so every gift is on-brand.

### Warehouse-backed fulfillment

Inventory is pre-produced, decorated, and stored in our warehouse. Orders ship within 1–2 business days — no print-on-demand wait times.

### CRM & API automation

Trigger gifts from Salesforce, HubSpot, or any system through the Brandmerch API. Map CRM events to gifting workflows with zero manual work.

### Multi-address shipping

Send to one recipient or thousands. Upload CSV address lists, let recipients enter their own address via a storefront link, or push addresses through the API.

### Budget controls & credits

Assign spending limits per team, campaign, or individual sender. Use prepaid credits or invoiced billing to keep gifting programs on budget.

### Tracking & reporting

Monitor every send from creation to delivery. Filter by campaign, date range, or team. Export reports for finance reviews and ROI analysis.
